verses.pali: … “Evameva kho, bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye dāsidāsapaṭiggahaṇā paṭiviratā; atha kho eteva bahutarā sattā ye dāsidāsapaṭiggahaṇā appaṭiviratā …pe….
verses.english: “… the sentient beings who refrain from receiving male and female bondservants are few, while those who don’t refrain are many. …”
